name: codebrain
description: Local semantic code intelligence for VS Code: native-accelerated runtime, MCP, impact analysis, affected tests, workflow graphs, and read-only AI review.

untrustedWorkspaces.description: CodeBrain executes its bundled local runtime and reads workspace source files.

virtualWorkspaces.description: The local CodeBrain runtime requires a filesystem-backed workspace.

chatParticipants.name: codebrain
chatParticipants.description: Explain workflows or review code with CodeBrain context.

commands.name: explain
commands.description: Explain the business workflow and show the concrete code flow with a developer-friendly Markdown and Mermaid report.

commands.name: review
commands.description: Run one graph-grounded review covering architecture, contracts, blast radius, code correctness, boundary safety, test gaps, and release readiness.

commands.name: impact
commands.description: Analyze change impact, detect affected tests, classify risk, and report estimated token savings.

commands.name: fix
commands.description: Analyze a bug, trace its root cause through the code graph, and propose a concrete solution and validation plan.

commands.name: guide
commands.description: Generate a user-facing Markdown guide for using a feature, including prerequisites, steps, examples, and troubleshooting.

disambiguation.description: Explains what code does, why it exists, and how control or data flows through functions.
examples: What is this function used for?
How does this request workflow work?
Explain the purpose of the selected code.

disambiguation.description: Reviews architecture and changed workflows together with code correctness, boundary safety, affected methods, regressions, test gaps, and release risk.
examples: What can break if I change this?
Assess the release risk and missing tests for this diff.

disambiguation.description: Traces changed files through dependent workflows and identifies the indexed tests that should run.
examples: Which tests are affected by my changes?
Phân tích ảnh hưởng của thay đổi này.

commands.title: CodeBrain: Export Latest Report as Markdown
CodeBrain: Dismiss All Review Findings in File

codebrain.autoRefresh.enabled.description: Keep the index fresh with CodeBrain's native watcher while the bundled MCP runtime is active.

codebrain.autoRefresh.debounceMs.description: Quiet period before a burst of file changes is incrementally synced.

codebrain.chat.maxContextFiles.description: Maximum number of source files returned by CodeBrain for a chat report.

codebrain.chat.maxDiffCharacters.description: Maximum Git diff size supplied to code review commands. Larger diffs are truncated with an explicit warning.

codebrain.chat.showTokenUsage.description: Show model-specific estimated token counts and latency for each CodeBrain chat request.

codebrain.impact.maxDepth.description: Maximum dependency depth for affected-test detection.

codebrain.metrics.enabled.description: Store workspace-local estimates of context tokens and file reads saved by impact analysis.

codebrain.ai.model.description: Language model id for CodeBrain-owned AI commands such as Review Changes. Leave empty to use the first available model. This does not override the model selected for CodeBrain ChatParticipant requests.

codebrain.review.instructionFile.description: Workspace-relative Markdown file with additional CodeBrain review priorities. Core review safety rules cannot be overridden.

enumDescriptions: UI behavior, state, accessibility, browser security, and frontend performance.
API contracts, security, persistence, reliability, and operations.
End-to-end UI, API, persistence, and contract consistency.
Memory safety, concurrency, real-time behavior, and embedded recovery.
Threat boundaries, authorization, data exposure, and abuse cases.
Latency, throughput, resource usage, and failure recovery.
Regression matrix, migration safety, and release readiness.
codebrain.review.profile.description: Built-in review priorities for this workspace. Extend them with codebrain.review.instructionFile when needed.

codebrain.review.refreshIndexBeforeRun.description: Refresh the CodeBrain index before impact analysis and review when the workspace has changed since the last refresh. Analyses stop if a needed refresh fails instead of using stale graph data.

codebrain.reports.openPreview.description: Automatically open generated Markdown reports in VS Code's preview.

codebrain.codeLens.enabled.description: Show each file's blast radius (dependents and affected tests) as a CodeLens above line 1.

codebrain.impact.detectDepthTruncation.description: Probe one level past codebrain.impact.maxDepth to detect whether the dependency traversal was cut short. When it was, CodeBrain reports the dependent counts as a lower bound instead of presenting them as complete.

codebrain.tests.command.description: Command used by "CodeBrain: Run Affected Tests". Use ${files} where the affected test paths should go (for example: npx vitest run ${files}). Leave empty to detect the project's test runner and confirm before running.

scripts.build: npm run check && npm run bundle
scripts.build:all: npm run build:runtime && npm run build
